name: decision-preflight
description: Detect material implicit choices and preflight technical decisions against evidence, authority, and derivation.

interface.shortDescription: Find implicit choices and check their grounds.
interface.longDescription: Detect material choices at implementation handoff, during implementation, and in review, including indirect behavior in accepted designs. Separate current behavior, capability, intent, and derived requirements while preserving settled choices and keeping mechanical work out of scope.
defaultPrompt: Preflight this architecture decision before I choose.
Check this implementation handoff for material choices the accepted design does not cover.
Recheck this recommendation against the available evidence.
Review material implementation behavior and the requirements or derivations supporting it.
